invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null data stream for processing; passing null would cause a NullPointerException.
The flat map function is essential for processing; it must not be null for function application.
Reduce function is required for aggregation; if null, reduce operation would fail.
Parallelism should be positive; otherwise the intended parallel processing cannot occur.
data should be a valid Stream instance to allow parallel() and iterator() calls.
